headline: Anthropic sponsors 41 percent of House members amid pricing surge
body: Anthropic has expanded its political influence by sponsoring 178 House members across both parties while simultaneously raising API prices 10x for some customers. The move signals the company's growing confidence in its market position and willingness to shape regulatory environments. For healthcare AI implementations, this matters because Anthropic's pricing volatility and political engagement could influence how regulations around clinical AI tools evolve, potentially affecting deployment costs and compliance requirements. Healthcare vendors and IT leaders should monitor how Anthropic's legislative footprint translates into AI governance policies that could impact your organization's vendor selection and long-term AI strategy costs.
